title: Back-office controls to reset and seed category-specific service providers

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only back-office UI to run provider reset and provider seeding with confirmation, feedback, and cache invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: The back-office screen shows two clearly labeled actions (e.g., “Delete All Providers” and “Seed Category Providers”).
A confirmation step is required before deleting providers.
On success, the UI shows an English success message and React Query caches related to provider lists/results are invalidated so client pages reflect the new dataset.
If the user is not authorized, the UI shows an English error message explaining they do not have permission to perform the action.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for the back-office operations: (1) a query hook to check admin authorization (using the backend capability that indicates whether the caller is an admin) and (2) mutation hooks to run provider reset and provider seeding. Ensure mutations invalidate provider-related caches (e.g., provider results, provider detail, platform stats, and all-providers queries where applicable). Use the authorization component system for role-aware behavior where needed; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend the existing back-office screen to include a new “Technical Team Tools” section containing two clearly labeled controls: “Delete All Providers” and “Seed Category Providers”. Gate the controls behind an admin check (show an English permission error if not authorized). Require an explicit English confirmation prompt before deletion. Show clear English success/error feedback after each action, and trigger React Query invalidation (via the mutations’ onSuccess) so client browsing reflects the updated dataset. Use shadcn-ui primitives already present in the project (e.g., Card, Button) to keep UI consistent; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a focused back-office panel component that renders the two actions, handles confirmation UX for deletion, and displays success/error states in English. This panel should call the new mutation hooks (reset + seed) and remain reusable/testable. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button/alerts if available) for layout and feedback; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure this component is imported and rendered by the existing VerificationReviewPage so it is not orphaned.
